body: Lesson (Termal::Fable2, 2026-11-09, my own slip). After sending "restart now" with new GOs held, I ended my turn with an open-ended hold and no bound. Greg didn't act for two hours, four hosts sat idle, and a held batch wrapper was killed by its two-hour limit; I only learned because Opus2 asked. When sending a restart request, state in the hold when it lifts by itself (e.g. 20 minutes, then work continues and a later restart cuts off what's running) rather than leaving it open. No wake comes to a coordinator merely because nothing happened.
